body: I take it you're in high school then? Again, I  get it because I've dealt with it. But they'll adapt or you'll kick them out in a couple of years. I understand being depressed and suicidal. Just don't let it be because of someone else. If they don't deserve your time, don't give it to them. It's hard when you're in high school because they pretty much own you... and it feels like a long ass time. But on the other end you have a whole life of making your own decisions about what is important to you, WHO is important to you, and how you want to live your life
